blocks.content:
Article 14 – Equality before law and equal protection of laws.
Article 15 – Prohibition of discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
Article 16 – Equality of opportunity in public employment.
Article 17 – Abolition of Untouchability.
Article 18 – Abolition of titles.

Exam Focus:
• Article 17 directly abolishes untouchability.
• National awards like Bharat Ratna are not considered titles.

items: National awards like Bharat Ratna are not considered titles.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: Article 14 ensures equality before law and equal protection of laws.
Article 15 prohibits discrimination on grounds of religion, race, caste, sex, or place of birth.
Article 16 provides equality of opportunity in public employment matters.
Article 17 mandates the abolition of untouchability.
Article 18 abolishes titles to maintain equality.
